label: A one-way transfer has finitely grounded power under the exercise and intrinsic-input bridges
paraphrase: If a finite-throughput ledger maps every positive transfer to an actual transmission and every net exporter to an intrinsic contributor in this respect, any recipient of a positive edge without a positive return path has finitely grounded power in the existing inductive sense. The result supplies one finite source path even with joint inputs. It makes no attribution of a particular share of the output.
